_note: Proposed subsections of TestRail section 136701 "Internal Work order (11/12/2026)" (suite 1, Founder Mode), one per story with plain names. Ids are null: no TestRail write by the case worker; the coordinator creates them with the QA lead's go-ahead. Story 11 (Open API and webhooks) lives in "API" (Rule 4: every case with API requests, responses or status codes). DATA holds the cross-surface number parity cases (Rule 116); INV the invariant set (Rule 96, skill 17: billable work orders and everything the PRD says is unchanged); S13 the starting categories a tester can see on a new organization; REL the release-day checks of existing organizations. "Design — how it looks" holds the design cases, including the held design-version cases waiting on the PO (Rule 126, Rule 130; QA lead: waiting design cases stay there). WAIT-PO, BLK and PROD are the standing folders (cases waiting on the PO, blocked on another release, run on production after the release); build.py assigns them. Cases a tester cannot set up are kept in the library only (NO-MANUAL-PROPOSAL.md) and are not written to TestRail. Final list after round 2b (12 Nov 2026): every key below is used by a case; REL is the story home of the release-day cases, all of which run on production after the release, so build.py files them in PROD and REL gets no TestRail subsection (create it only if the QA lead wants an empty story folder).
